name: Dasaku ~Arisu to Kuroe, Musubareru Hi~
original_name: 駄作 ～アリスとクロエ、結ばれる日～
source:
Three monsters found love and acceptance in each other. What happens when an unknown element is mixed in?

A continuation of [url=/c23152]Alice’s[/url] and [url=/c24085]Chloe’s[/url] routes from the first game.
translation:
三个怪物在彼此之间找到了爱与接纳。当一个未知因素被混入其中，会发生什么？

这是第一作中[url=/c23152]爱丽丝[/url]与[url=/c24085]克洛伊[/url]路线的续篇。
